title: The Rebuilt Athlete · Phase 00

authority.rule: The active backend block and immutable planned-session versions are the running prescription source of truth. This JSON mirrors the currently authored physical week for web review.

objective: Hold the newly reached ~31-mile running load while outdoor running becomes genuinely low aerobic and the body stays fluid, fueled and absorbable.
run_surface_rule: Outdoor running is used to practice low-aerobic control. Treadmill running is used for relaxed repetition and movement quality without forcing watch pace or heart-rate targets.
run_guardrails: This is a volume hold, not a mileage progression: 31 planned miles.
Monday and Thursday treadmill runs are feel-first: smooth, fluid and restrained.
Tuesday outdoor running stays in the athlete's current Zone 2 / low-aerobic range; slow for heat or drift.
Saturday is easy treadmill volume that must leave Sunday available.
Sunday is 10 miles outdoors with at least the first 7.5 miles low aerobic; the final 2.5 may open naturally only if movement remains fluid.
Do not make up missed miles by doubling.
Stacked training requires deliberate refueling and hydration; do not defend transient post-training scale loss.
form_scope: FORM carries the running prescription and running filing only. Forge owns strength execution and filing. Study 002 integrates the evidence.

weeks.intent: Reproduce the fluid, symmetrical running state without testing pace.
Hold volume. Improve aerobic control and keep the movement fluid.

segments.intent: stay low aerobic or open naturally only if fluid

Friday.recovery: No required running or cardio; eat, hydrate and keep the weekend available.

Sunday.run: 10 mi outdoors · first 7.5 mi low aerobic
Sunday.recovery: Refuel, hydrate, restore; walking / yoga open.
